guideLine: <p><strong>Print Guidelines</strong></p><p>Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups <a href="https://printway.larksuite.com/drive/folder/Echuf2BQDlpS4hdYozAuZwCEsKe">here</a></p><p><strong>To use an Art Template:</strong></p><ul><li>Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.</li><li>Insert your artwork in a new layer, <strong>placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template</strong> to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.</li><li>If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.</li><li>Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.</li><li>Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.</li><li>You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.<ul><li>Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.</li></ul></li></ul><p><strong>To ensure your design prints properly on each product:</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Fill the entire design template!</strong> The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.</li><li><i><strong>Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product. </strong></i></li></ul>
